# celestial epoch

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:celestialEpoch`](gmeow-celestialEpoch.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/celestialEpoch>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The epoch (Julian year, e.g. 2000.0) for which the coordinates are expressed. Required for proper-motion propagation; frame-relative per [Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11).

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:CelestialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialCoordinates.md) -> [`xsd:decimal`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the epoch (Julian year) for which celestial coordinates are expressed — required for proper-motion propagation.

### Avoid when

- Avoid omitting it for moving bodies and avoid confusing it with the temporal slice's observation time.

### How to use

- Add [`gmeow:celestialEpoch`](gmeow-celestialEpoch.md) to [`CelestialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialCoordinates.md) alongside the frame; frame-relative per [Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11).

### Examples

- ex:vegaCoords [`gmeow:celestialEpoch`](gmeow-celestialEpoch.md) 2000.0.
